What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[General Hux]]: left, the image of [[General Hux (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit e8445f0); right, the image of [[General Hux (Errata 3)]] (holotable commit 5637ac6). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/generalhux.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/5637ac69a300a13ed3aa4df39631e5415498a42e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/generalhux.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
